rationale: ButtonSurface, a new View subclass in widgets/button_surface.cpp (added to the view source list), paints Chromium's push-button theme: background, border, hover, pressed, disabled and the focus-visible ring. It is widget paint inside Pulp's own view layer, used only where a ButtonSurface is explicitly constructed; TextButton and generated UI are unchanged, and no design-import lowering, Chromium capture, renderer backend, asset or packaging authority moves.
